title: Jev request body
description: The body of POST https://api.typesafe.ai/v1/systemone, as documented at https://docs.typesafe.ai/api on 2026-10-04.

model.description: The model that handles the request. An alias such as jev-latest moves with each release. A versioned id such as jev-1.13.0 does not.

questions.description: A map of typed questions. You choose each key, and answers come back under the same keys.

type.description: noul answers yes or no. choice picks one option. score rates against ordered levels.

instructions.description: The question to evaluate. A string, or an object or array that holds the question and data it refers to.

criteria.description: noul: an optional object with 'true' and 'false'. choice: a map of option to description, at most 255. score: an ordered array of 2 to 10 level descriptions.

question.description: A typed question. JevLint-LE checks its shape and reports problems with a reason, so this schema only describes the fields.
